name: Skill Context tab: attach a doc, see how it serializes, detach
description: Deterministic (no model call) walk through the Context tab of the seeded skill 'uncovered-branches' (linked to Test Quality Reviewer) with the active repo acme/payments-api. Ticks specs/public-api.md (saves at once; badge reads '1 attached'); the 'Serializes as' box shows the '## Project context' heading and the '- specs/public-api.md' path line, never doc text (that no doc text appears is asserted by the component test: agent-browser has no 'is absent' wait). Unticks it at the end so the flow can run again. Attachments do not create skill versions. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB and the fixture mirror (hermetic runner / e2e-web.yml); flow 08 creates other skills only, so the order of flows does not matter.
